brand.name: Sanjeevni
brand.vision: Hyperlocal digital healthcare ecosystem blending fast commerce with clinical trust.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12 (Tetris Grid: Asymmetry, overlapping)
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 to gap-6 (Control Room Grid: High density, rigid)

spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons (organic feel)

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses Forest Green. Secondary uses Terracotta. Always specify hover states (e.g., hover:bg-[#0A3629]).
components.cards: Subtle 1px border. No heavy drop shadows. Internal padding p-6 or p-8.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. 1px border. High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-primary).
components.navigation: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80) with 1px delicate bottom border.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero.description: Delivery partner on a scooter representing 20-minute delivery promise.

products.description: Medicine and pharmacy bottles for product catalog cards.

doctors.description: Professional doctor portraits for consultation booking.

maps.description: Map representation for order tracking and live ETA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Avoid generic Bootstrap blue or default Tailwind blue. Use the provided Deep Forest Green (#0F4C3A) for primary branding to convey organic trust.
Ensure 'Outfit' font is used for all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Apply tracking-tight to headings over 32px.
Implement a mobile-first design. The main landing page should feature a one-tap 'Reorder' section prominently.
Checkout flow must be one-screen (minimal fields, clear cost/ETA) to match quick commerce best practices.
Use the provided image_urls for the hero, product catalog, doctor consultations, and order tracking. Do not use placeholder services (e.g., via.placeholder.com).
All cards must have a generous internal padding (p-6) to avoid text collision with borders.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and key UI elements for automated testing.
Include dark mode logic following the color scale provided under colors.dark.
Build the dashboard using the 'Control Room' grid strategy (dense, no heavy cards) and marketing pages using 'Tetris' grid (asymmetrical, breathing room).
